description: Causal claims strongest in abstract + results (we demonstrate an EQE of 21.4%); soften to associative in discussion (these results suggest that charge balance governs recombination); speculative in outlook. Never strengthen hedge backward across sections.

Every number / abbreviation / device metric (EQE, luminance, cd m^-2^, T50) / material or layer name (NiOx, ZnMgO, TPBi) in entity_registry must appear byte-identically in every section that mentions it.
Numeric superscripts assigned in order of first mention; never reused; contiguous across sections.
First occurrence in the paper = full term + parenthetical abbreviation (external quantum efficiency (EQE); nickel oxide (NiOx)); later occurrences = abbreviation only. Cross-section identical.
SP001 / SP004 house style: methods is the final section written, after discussion (and after the last Results subsection when discussion is folded into Results).
First sentence of section N must reference the claim, device or metric that closed section N-1 (e.g., the 16.3% EQE or the passivated InP QDs).

The same underlying claim receives the same hedge tier across abstract / intro / results / discussion; do not casually downgrade (the charge-balance mechanism stays associative if only J-V asymmetry supports it).
Every section's lead sentence must trace back to one item in logic_line or story_arc (synthesis -> characterization -> device metrics -> mechanism attribution).
Numerals 10+ (Arabic), 1-9 spelled out (per R023); consistent within and across sections (2.2 V turn-on, 30 devices, sixteen batches).
Citation density: intro 5-10/section (record EQE and prior passivation strategies), results 0-2 (own data), discussion 1/paragraph (comparison tables of reported QLEDs).
